name: Sai Kiran Kumar Nalla
headline: Medical imaging scientist × AI builder
tagline: I build virtual PET scanners, 3D-printed ground truth, and the AI agents that run the research.
now: Building an agentic framework that turns PET/CT into auditable virtual patients and simulations, as the foundation for small generative and surrogate models for PET/CT simulation and dosimetry.

points: Built CASSOULET PET/CT simulator and research digital twins (MATLAB, Python, PyTomography, parallelproj) with agentic LLM workflows
Dual-centre phantom studies for harmonised quantification
Collaborations with GE HealthCare, eMotion Tech, Rambam, Mahindra University
Predictive models for a minimally invasive cancer-treatment device
MATLAB CT/MRI segmentation and visualisation toolbox
Soft gels and particle suspensions for drug delivery

programmes: SATT Paris-Saclay × E4H From Research to Market (2023)
